title.narrative: Accelerate Uganda: Automotive & Electric Vehicle Training Programme

description.narrative: The purpose with the project “Accelerate Uganda” is to engage Danish auto mechanic apprentices in the sustainable development goals 4, 8 and 17 and international development cooperation in Uganda. Via the project ZBC and its partner Uganda Industrial Research Institute (UIRI), seek to establish a solid partnership in Uganda where young Danish auto mechanics can intern in a safe and well-organized VET institution and to give young Ugandan mechanics a high-quality mechanics course in Uganda. By facilitating professional exchange visits and peer to peer SDG training modules and a comprehensive engagement activity plan in Denmark, ZBC and its Ugandan partners aim to maximize engagement impacts for the projects target groups and lay the foundation for a strong partnership on auto mechanical VET training in Uganda.
